summary: renew-internal-tls.yml meets P2's outcome: one play over proxmox:k8s:openbao reaches all ten leaves through P1's declarations with nothing restated, resolves to the predicted 11 hosts and cuts cleanly into P3's two scopes. I reproduced the two load-bearing mechanisms against the pinned ansible-core — cross-role handler resolution under a conditional import_role, and force_handlers rescuing a pending reload on a host that fails after issuance while its peers complete and the run still exits non-zero. One advisory finding: a comment misattributes why serial: costs fleet coverage.

findings.summary: The no-serial comment (renew-internal-tls.yml:64-71) claims serial: defaults max_fail_percentage to 0; it has no default and the linear strategy skips it unless set — the real break is the batch-fully-failed check in playbook_executor.py:190-195, so the remedy the comment implies does not work.
